title: A Declaration of Pen Against Heaven
next_chapter_hook: From the depths of the Universe's Eye comes the laughter of the ultimate Chess Player: 'Interesting. The first chess piece in ten thousand years to dare resist.'

text.content: The moment the ancient text entered his hands, Chen Ji's surroundings blazed with spiritual light. The originally mottled cover turned pages on its own, revealing dense符文 within. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul smiled with satisfaction: 'The Tianji Record has nine pages, and seven have now returned to you. Lad, your father collected eight pages back then yet failed to accomplish what you have done.' Before his words finished, Chen Ji's Mental Sea shook violently—a will surpassing countless ages pierced through from the endless Void, carrying the indifference of surveying ants.

That will was vast and boundless, like the weight of the entire universe pressing down on his divine soul. Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea churning, countless stellar visions exploding before his eyes. A cold voice rang directly in the depths of his consciousness: [Ant, you have touched what should not be touched.] A mere thread of will made Chen Ji's seven orifices bleed, his knees involuntarily bending. But he gripped the ancient text tightly, knuckles white, teeth clenched to breaking, yet refusing to kneel.

dialogue.content: [The Tianji Record is a chess piece I set down. Through countless ages, countless prophets have gone mad and fallen for it. You are merely a chosen vessel—what qualification do you have to bear the complete Heavenly Secrets? Kneel, surrender it, and I shall grant you glory for a lifetime.] The voice brooked no argument, as if Heaven itself were passing judgment.

text.content: Intense pain racked Chen Ji's Mental Sea as the Tianji Record's runes collided violently with that cosmic will. He saw countless images—generations of prophets kneeling before the Tianji Record, sacrificing their souls, ultimately turning to nothingness. Among them were prodigies of stunning brilliance, overlords ruling territories,无一例外 all became discarded pieces in Heaven's chess game. The next one, was him—Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: How does Chen Ji respond to the pressure of the Heavenly Eye?

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a pen, inscribe a declaration rebelling against fate's chains within the Mental Sea, engaging the cosmic existence in direct confrontation. Extreme risk, but success would completely break Heaven's control over the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of Heavenly Fate, possible soul damage
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye retreats temporarily, gaining the title 'Heaven Defier'
choices.risk_hint: Direct confrontation with Heaven's will—failure means complete soul destruction

text.content: Chen Ji laughed toward the sky, blood flowing down the corners of his mouth, yet laughing wildly and unrestrainedly: 'Heaven? You are merely a coward hiding behind the scenes, manipulating chess pieces! Through ten thousand years, how many brilliant talents have died in your designed chess games? Today, I, Chen Ji, shall use this pen to strike down your so-called Heaven!'

choices.description: 表面上跪拜屈服，实则暗中以天机录推演天道意志的破绽，等待反击the right moment。保留实力，但可能被天道进一步控制。
choices.visible_cost: fate消耗较少，但可能被植入控制印记
choices.visible_reward: 保留完整实力，获得天道trust以获取情报
choices.risk_hint: 长期屈服可能导致人格扭曲，且天道印记难以清除

text.content: Chen Ji's knees slowly bent, but in the instant of bowing, a cold light flashed in his eyes. He thought secretly: 'Noted. When I figure out your true nature, I'll let you know what it means to have foresight without flaw.' He chose temporary surrender, secretly using the Tianji Record to deduce Heaven's weaknesses.

choices.text: Counter Heaven with Heavenly Secrets, Set Trap for Counter-Attack
choices.description: 调动天机录全部力量，以天道之道还施彼身，在对方的意志中植入反噬种子。不是硬碰硬，而是turn their force against them。
choices.visible_cost: Tianji Record temporarily exposes all abilities, may be analyzed by Heaven
choices.visible_reward: Plants counter-attack seeds within Heaven's will, can be countered in the future
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record's abilities exposed, loses element of surprise in future battles

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes wide, the Tianji Record's runes spinning frantically in his pupils. He no longer resisted that will, instead actively welcoming it, counteracting Heaven with Heaven's own methods, quietly planting a seed of counter-attack within the opposing will's torrent. 'You want to devour the Tianji Record? Then let me give you a taste of being counter-attacked by Heavenly Secrets.'

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the pressure from the Heavenly Eye reached its peak. Lightning flashed and thunder roared in his Mental Sea, countless threads of karma wrapping around his divine soul, attempting to lock him down completely. But at this critical moment, a warm power surged from the depths of the Tianji Record—Chen Xuan's final legacy left by his father, resisting Heaven's will.

[Interesting.] The will of the Heavenly Eye slightly fluctuated, as if seeing a new toy, [Chen Xuan also struggled like you back then, ultimately turning to dust. What makes you think you can be different?] Chen Ji sensed the faint mockery in that will, and instead a heroic spirit surged in his heart—being treated as a toy by the ultimate Chess Player was the most ironic compliment he had ever received.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently trembled within the ancient text, letting out a hoarse warning: 'Lad, the Heavenly Eye cannot be confronted head-on! It has existed for who knows how many epochs—you and I combined are nothing but dust in its eyes!' But Chen Ji laughed instead, madly and resolutely—he had waited too long for this day.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji let out a long roar toward the sky, his voice shaking the Mental Sea: 'Through ten thousand years, how many talents have turned to bones in your chess game? Chen Xuan, Yi Fenghan, Liu Ruyan... Do you even remember their names? No, you only remember chess pieces! Today, I, Chen Ji, shall overturn this chessboard, and let Heaven taste the滋味 of being schemed against!'

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly used his finger as a pen, his Mental Sea as paper, Heavenly Secrets as ink, and began frenzied inscription—that was no ordinary writing, but declarations breaking causality and transcending fate. Where the runes passed, Heaven's woven threads of karma shattered one after another, creating a vacuum zone within the Mental Sea that不受 Heaven's control.

[Presumptuous!] The [Heavenly Eye] raged with fury, an unimaginable torrent of will pouring down like the collapse of the entire universe pressing toward Chen Ji. But Chen Ji was completely unafraid, continuing to strike Heaven with his pen, inscribing those declarations word by word into the river of fate—'My fate is mine to control, not Heaven's!'

The battle in the Mental Sea had surpassed ordinary cultivators' comprehension. Chen Ji's soul bounced between the edges of collapse, each character inscribed requiring pain like being crushed to pieces. But gritting his teeth, he persisted, stroke by stroke, completing the entire declaration. In an instant, golden light blazed in the Mental Sea, that declaration transformed into a light piercing through the heavens, shooting toward the endless depths of the Void.

choice.prompt: The declaration is complete, Heaven's Eye's will begins to waver—how does Chen Ji conclude?

choices.description: When the Heavenly Eye retreats is precisely when it is weak. Chen Ji seizes this moment to inject the Tianji Record's power deep into the opposing will, leaving a permanent mark.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate大量消耗，可能被反噬
choices.visible_reward: Plants permanent烙印 within the Heavenly Eye, can be triggered at critical moments in the future
choices.risk_hint: Aggressive pursuit may provoke Heaven, leading to more violent retaliation

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, his finger moved again, transforming a thread of the Tianji Record's source power into a seed, quietly injecting it into that retreating will. 'A souvenir, Mr. Chess Player. Hope you can still laugh when we meet next time.'

choices.description: The purpose has been achieved; there's no need to fight Heaven to the death. Chen Ji decisively withdrew, preserving these hard-won gains.
choices.visible_reward: Retains complete strength, leaving room for future arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye may retaliate with加倍 after recovery

text.content: Chen Ji stood down, coldly watching that will retreat into the depths of the Void. He knew clearly that today was merely the first exchange with Heaven; the true game was just beginning. Exposing too many trump cards now would be counterproductive.

That light piercing through the heavens shot directly into the endless depths of the Void. The Heavenly Eye's will violently shook. It perceived something it had never anticipated—a mortal, daring to inscribe a declaration not belonging to Heaven in the river of fate! This was not mere rebellion; this was tearing a hole in its chessboard!

[Interesting.] The Heavenly Eye's will fluctuated again, and this time, a hint of amusement appeared in that indifferent tone, [Ten thousand years, and finally one dares to bare its fangs at me. Remember this feeling, little one. Next time, I will use true power to make you understand—what is Heaven.] Before the words finished, that terrifying will-pressure receded like a tide, leaving only a ravaged Mental Sea.

Chen Ji gasped heavily, every part of his body in intense pain, his soul like it had been torn apart and hastily stitched back together. But the corner of his mouth curved into a smile—he had gambled correctly. The Heavenly Eye could not kill him, but chose to observe. In this game, he had temporarily held the line. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sigh from within the ancient text: 'Lad, your father also reached this point once, but he wasn't as crazy as you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji collapsed to the ground, yet laughed heartily: 'Crazy? I call this being awake. The difference between a madman and a genius is simply—who's still standing in the end.' He raised his head toward the depths of the Void, where a low laughter faintly echoed—the ultimate Chess Player re-examining this unexpectedly rebellious chess piece.

text.content: The Tianji Record's runes gradually calmed, but Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. The Heavenly Eye's temporary retreat did not mean it would let things go. That ultimate Chess Player was hiding in the depths of the Void, observing him with entirely new eyes—a mole daring to declare war on it. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, with rare gravity: 'Lad, what you did today, the entire universe will remember. From now on, you are Heaven's certified rebel, and the first person in ten thousand years qualified to overturn the chessboard.'

Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his body dim with spiritual light, his soul severely wounded, but those eyes shone brighter than ever. He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record in his hands—seven pages returned, runes flowing, as if celebrating a new master's birth. And in the depths of the Void, the ultimate Chess Player's laughter still echoed—[Interesting. The first chess piece in ten thousand years to dare resist.] This voice was both threat and acknowledgment. Chen Ji knew that from this moment, he was no longer a piece, but a player. And this game against Heaven had just begun.
